channels.name: Open25-DM32 Classic
channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · DMR, FM and conventional P25

releases.notes: Classic r11 fixes the missing P25 mode choice in Classic CPS after connecting by advertising conventional P25 in the firmware VERSION response. Regression tests use the real firmware response. It retains the r10 RX-only defaults for new/copied channels and changed transmit frequencies outside the amateur bands. Turning RX-only off requires an explicit Enable TX confirmation in the firmware and matching Classic CPS. Existing RFKV programming is preserved; the independent P25 transmit-band restriction is unchanged. RFKV programming only: retired Classic formats are not imported. The application-only package uses the radio’s own DMR codec and preserves the bootloader and data chip during flashing. Full host software, sanitizer, browser, target stack/ABI, warning and identical forced-rebuild checks passed. Physical-radio qualification of this release has not been performed. Known issues: PL/CTCSS can drop during DTMF, and an intermittent P25 PTT startup with no RF remains under investigation. Save a full backup before installing.
